Sans.figmaStyle: Regular 400 / Medium 500 / Semi Bold 600 per text style

fontMapping.note: Figma already has Noto Serif KR Medium headings and Inter body styles; this file matches them. Sizes, line heights and weights are identical on both sides, but glyph widths are not: the web renders Georgia / Arial first (then an installed Noto face for Hangul), so line breaks and heading line counts can differ from Figma. Inter has no Hangul glyphs, so Korean body text in Figma is drawn by a fallback font. Font files are not bundled.

Table.layout: header meta over 1px textPrimary; cells padding 16, 1px border row rules; wrapper scrolls horizontally
Table.anatomy: caption, summary, sortable headers, rows, state row

v1_3.virtual: prop {height:336,rowHeight:56}; windowed rows, role=grid + aria-activedescendant, keys ↑↓ PageUp PageDown Home End, 'full page' alternative; virtual cells single-line with title

Pagination.layout: horizontal gap 16; numbers 44x44; current 600 + 2px accent underline; mobile shows 'n / total'

Toast.anatomy: icon square, tone word, title, message, action, close

v1_3.ToastRegion.max: latest N visible + hidden count note

notApplicable.empty: single-story page has no empty list state

figma.format: Custom handoff manifest; not a native Figma import or Tokens Studio file.
instructions: Create local variables using variables names; convert COLOR hex to normalized RGBA if scripting.
Create text styles separately using textStyles and fontMapping.
Create 1440 / 834 / 390 px frames and apply foundation.grid / responsive values.
Build components with Auto Layout per componentSpecs; compose templates per templateSpecs.
Drag preview/figma-board.svg into Figma as an editable visual reference. It does not create variables, components or Auto Layout.
Build the 16 derived-extension families from componentSpecs (status = derived-extension) with DEW variables only; do not import IAK styles.

authority.coverage: IAK Design Studio case inventory only
authority.fontFallback: Preserve appearance, weight and metrics; use a similar available font only when missing. Record substitutions.

tokens.note: Only new token. Semantic meaning uses existing palette + words + icons.

semantic.danger: accent outline/icon/2px rule + textPrimary text (accent never text)

stateMap.selected: 2px accent underline (nav, pagination, sort) or 2px textPrimary inset (Card)
stateMap.errorRetry: AlertDialog: accent-bordered surface message + retry button (derived-extension)

designOnlySamples.note: Visual samples (.dew-dsample*) only; not component variants; no runtime support.
